queries_run: Fair Isaac FICO tariff OR export control OR trade restriction 2026

findings.claim: FICO 10-K 列出出口管制與制裁法規（OFAC、EAR）適用於其在非美國地區交付的產品；風險因素亦提及關稅變動與貿易壁壘為國際業務風險，FY2026 營收 20% 來自美國以外。
findings.excerpt: Laws and regulations restricting transactions with sanctioned parties and regarding export controls as they apply to FICO products delivered in non-U.S. countries or to foreign nationals (e.g., Office of Foreign Asset Control sanctions and Export Administration Regulations)

findings.claim: 風險因素將關稅與報復性關稅、貿易緊張列為可能壓抑客戶（銀行業占營收 92%）支出與延長銷售週期的總經因素；未見 FICO 特定關稅或出口管制事件。
findings.excerpt: During fiscal 2026, 92% of our revenues were derived from sales of products and services to the banking industry.

note: 標準搜尋未見 FICO 特定關稅／出口管制／實體清單事件；軟體業無實體商品供應鏈，僅有一般性風險揭露。
